keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, no Cliopatria row (Cliopatria draws the land as Soviet in 1946). The pages name 'Iranian Azerbaijan' and no provinces and give no area, so the region is the researcher's reading. The Mahabad Republic claimed 'three cities - Urmia, Khoy and Salmas - held by the Azerbaijan People's Government', which puts them inside this state.

ledger.note: 20 November 1945: the Azerbaijan Democratic Party seizes Tabriz and the province. The page's infobox gives 'established 20 November 1945'; the militia 'started a bloodless coup on 18 November 1945' and captured 'all remaining government posts in the province' by 21 November; 'In December the Democratic Party of Azerbaijan announced the establishment of an autonomous state of Azerbaijan' (no day). The Iran crisis page has 'By mid-December 1945' for the two republics. 'The Soviet military supported the new autonomous entity'; the page calls it a 'puppet state of the Soviet Union'.

ledger.note: 11-12 December 1946: the Iranian army retakes Tabriz. 'On December 11, an Iranian force entered Tabriz and the Peeshavari government quickly collapsed'; infobox 'disestablished 12 December 1946'; the Soviet Union had 'revoked its support' (the Iran crisis page: its troops 'left as of May 6' 1946).
